title: Clearing a fixed sell price still recalculates from the matrix
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, on matrix A.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing category A, with one range from $0.00 and Default on Markup % 50.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test, part A, in category A, cost $10.00, with a fixed sell price of $40.00.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open part A in the inventory.
  2. Clear the sell price.
  3. Save the part.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's dialog shows the sell price $40.00.

Step 2:

  • The sell price is empty.

Step 3:

  • Part A's sell price is recalculated from matrix A (category A's matrix): $15.00 ($10.00 × 1.50 = $15.00).
  • The green "Fixed sell price" label is gone.
